source.excerpt: To have courage for whatever comes in life
trail: Wikiquote transcribes the saying and gives The Little Lamp (1981), p. 80, associated with Eknath Easwaran. That original issue was not inspected here.
The Blue Mountain Center’s own history identifies its work preserving Easwaran’s teachings and explains the Little Lamp name. It does not establish a Teresa source for this sentence.
No Spanish wording, original work, composition date or English translator was verified.

author.heading: About Unknown
author.bio: The creator of this exact English wording has not been established. Teresa of Ávila (1515–1582), the person named in the attribution, was a Spanish Carmelite reformer and spiritual writer whose major works include The Life, The Way of Perfection and The Interior Castle. A modern English quotation credit needs an identifiable textual link to those writings.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The located reference transmits the saying through Eknath Easwaran’s modern meditation publishing rather than directly from Teresa’s manuscripts. The Blue Mountain Center presents its teaching as usable across religious traditions. That later inspirational setting explains a route of circulation while leaving the earlier source and translation unresolved.
